changelog:
music-lyric-set 0.1.1

- Adds detailed documentation and pack creation workflow in SKILL.md.
- Clarifies that each lyric card still is based only on user-supplied lyrics and named sections—never invent or look up missing lines.
- Outlines a transparent, step-by-step process for planning, approval, billing, and delivery of lyric card packs.
- Details specific instructions for integration with the bundled MCP client for all remote operations.
- Explains update, billing, and recovery processes for reliability and user safety.
summary: Turn user-supplied song lyrics into a four-to-eight still music lyric card set. This lyric-to-card studio lays out each named lyric section as its own still. Use it for music lyric card packs, lyric flashcards, and matching lyric card graphics.
